content.title: Kratos (NASDAQ:KTOS) Surprises With Q3 Sales But Stock Drops
content.summary: Aerospace and defense company Kratos (NASDAQ:KTOS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 26% year on year to $347.6 million. Revenue guidance for the full year exceeded analysts’ estimates, but next quarter’s guidance of $325 million was less impressive, coming in 2.5% below expectations. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.14 per share was 17.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
